title: Continuous sections of a topological algebra as condensed module objects
statement: Let $A$ and $T$ be commutative topological rings in a common universe and let $T$ be an $A$-algebra with continuous scalar multiplication, so the structural unital ring homomorphism $a:A\to T$ is continuous. Use the continuous-function condensed rings $\underline A(S)=C(S,A)$ and $\underline T(S)=C(S,T)$ on the coherent site of profinite sets [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Define the continuous-section $\underline A$-module object [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] to be restriction of the regular $\underline T$-module along the postcomposition ring-object morphism $a_*:\underline A\to\underline T$ [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. Its sections are $C(S,T)$, restrictions are precomposition, and the action is pointwise: $(b\cdot f)(s)=a(b(s))f(s)$.
